page_title: WOL 3-0 EVE | Wolves v Everton 30/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' The match has just finished.
90+9' A quickly taken corner by Wolves.
90+5' Pedro Neto (Wolves) has a goal ruled out for offside!

90+4' Arnaut Danjuma (Everton) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Thomas Bramall blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
90+1' Pedro Neto (Wolves) finds himself in a promising position to finish! He unleashes a poor shot which flies into the stands. What a poor effort that was!
90' There will be a minimum of 9 min. of added time.
89' Referee Thomas Bramall halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Sean Dyche, then shows him a yellow.
87' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Wolves.
85' Gary O'Neil has decided to substitute Joao Gomes and he is replaced by Boubacar Traore (Wolves).
85' Substitution. Nelson Semedo is replaced by Matt Doherty (Wolves).
83' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Jack Harrison (Everton), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
80' Substitution. Pablo Sarabia did his best and is replaced by Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves).
80' Gary O'Neil has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Pedro Neto (Wolves) replacing Matheus Cunha.
78' Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Jose Sa, who smothers the ball.
75' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Wolves comes to nothing.
74' Dwight McNeil will be replaced by Arnaut Danjuma (Everton).
74' It will be a substitution. Beto (Everton) is ready to enter the pitch as Dominic Calvert-Lewin walks off.
73' Gary O'Neil decides to make a substitution. Rayan Ait Nouri will be replaced by Hugo Bueno (Wolves).
73' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
71' Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) gets inside the box and tries to beat Jordan Pickford with a measured shot into the left side of the goal, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
70' The ball possession at the moment is 54:46.
69' Joao Gomes (Wolves) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the middle of the goal, but Jordan Pickford pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.

68' OFF THE CROSSBAR! Dwight McNeil (Everton) runs towards the goal to give his teammate support. He receives a fantastic pass and shoots from the edge of the box, but it crashes against the crossbar. It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.
67' James Tarkowski (Everton) gets booked for the first time in this match.
65' Some great controlled play and passing from Wolves. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
63' Thomas Bramall sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
63' Sean Dyche prepares a substitution. Nathan Patterson is replaced by Seamus Coleman (Everton).
63' Andre Gomes (Everton) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Michael Keane.
63' The Wolves players halt their celebrations as referee Thomas Bramall makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
61' 3 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Matheus Cunha plays it into the box, and Craig Dawson (Wolves) gets on the end of the cross to put it into the bottom right corner. 3:0.
61' Wolves can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
61' Off the post! Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) amazingly found his way through the defence, but lacked a precise finish as his effort from close range bounced off the left post.
59' Jarrad Branthwaite (Everton) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
59' The foul by Max Kilman (Wolves) was seen by Thomas Bramall who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.

57' Rayan Ait Nouri (Wolves) attempted to send a defence-splitting pass into space where Pablo Sarabia was lurking. It could have put him one-on-one with the goalkeeper, but one of the defending players somehow manages to avert the threat.
53' 2 - 0 Goal! Hee-Chan Hwang plays a pass to the feet of Matheus Cunha (Wolves), and he shoots into the back of the net from inside the box. It's 2:0.
50' James Tarkowski (Everton) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
48' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
48' Craig Dawson (Wolves) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
46' Referee Thomas Bramall blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+5' Dwight McNeil (Everton) is cautioned by the referee, who shows him a yellow card.
45+5' Thomas Doyle (Wolves) goes in the referee's notebook after being shown a yellow card.
45+2' Everton take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
45+1' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) offside.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
43' That's a clear yellow card. Rayan Ait Nouri (Wolves) goes into the book.
41' Wolves are awarded a free kick near the side line and the players make their way into the box for the inevitable cross.
39' Amadou Onana (Everton) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
38' The game is interrupted now, Amadou Onana (Everton) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
36' Dwight McNeil (Everton) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
31' Thomas Bramall blows his whistle and it's Jack Harrison (Everton) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
28' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) gets a shot from inside the penalty area and it flies just wide of the left post.
25' 1 - 0 Goal! Max Kilman (Wolves) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the left post. It's 1:0.
24' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
24' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
23' Nathan Patterson (Everton) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
20' Joao Gomes (Wolves) is clearly in an offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
18' Dwight McNeil (Everton) tries to play a through ball from just inside the box to Dominic Calvert-Lewin, but one of the defending players is alert to the danger and makes a timely interception.
17' Everton keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
15' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
15' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) places a shot at goal from the edge of the box that bends just wide of the right post.
11' Jack Harrison (Everton) finds Dominic Calvert-Lewin with a nice pass so he can go on towards the goal.
7' A great run by Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) gets him into the box, but his powerful shot is bravely blocked by a defender.
7' Everton will take a free kick from near the half-way line.
6' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Jack Harrison.
4' Wolves enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
2' Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
1' The match has just started.
The players are on the pitch and Everton will have the kick-off.
Thomas Bramall will referee today's match.
